description: Germany only. Look up one German employment law value (Rechtswert) by its key, e.g. mindestlohn (minimum wage), minijobGrenze, bbgRv, urlaubMindest. Returns the value valid on the given date, all dated values, the legal norm, the official source link, the date it was last checked and its status.

kennung.description: Key of the value, e.g. mindestlohn

stichtag.description: Date the value should apply to, default today (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: rechtswert
title: Rechtswert mit Quelle
